not_tested: No public HTTP, WebSocket, or MCP entry point exposes a scheduled consolidation run or revert, so the live sandbox cannot directly drive the mechanical consolidation behaviors. Integration coverage is explicit in apps/api_server/src/__tests__/memory_consolidation_drafter.test.ts (#1193: merges a three-note attribution cluster and reverts byte-for-byte; #1193: capture and consolidation produce the same attribution merge; AC4: the pass is reversible via a before-snapshot) and apps/api_server/src/__tests__/memory_cross_links.test.ts (rewrites retiree backlinks to the survivor and revert restores exact bytes; rewrites every parsed live backlink while leaving malformed bytes untouched).

The public lifecycle routes assign the verification timestamp server-side and expose no stable at input, so an exact duplicate (by, at) replay cannot be constructed in the live sandbox. Integration coverage is apps/api_server/src/__tests__/memory_verification.test.ts (appends later confirmations and dedupes an exact by/at retry).

The credential-free live sandbox can prove unauthenticated human verification fails closed, but cannot prove the authenticated owner-success and cross-owner-not-found branches without a human identity/session. Integration coverage is apps/api_server/src/__tests__/memory_verification_route.test.ts (uses authenticated human identity and ignores a forged request actor; returns 404 for another owner and leaves the vault bytes unchanged).
